Select approved drugs with a breast cancer indication. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where mesh_heading equals 'breast cancer' and max_phase_for_ind is 4. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
